name: kwapso-design
status: IN PROGRESS. Restructured 2026-08-24 to the four names the client uses: foundations (tokens/ icons/ motion/) · controls/ (67) · structures/ (42) · compositions/ (45 in four folders: 15 templates, 17 screens, 8 overlays, 5 states). components/ no longer exists. Twenty-four files and 11,731 lines of example collection and detail routes were deleted — the kit ships the TEMPLATE and the application builds the page. docs/ is complete (all five). Icons are the Iconoir pack (MIT), vendored 2026-08-26 over the placeholder set. Outstanding: `foundations/` is not yet a folder (see foundationsFolder below).

tokens.renamedFromNote: Empty by decision. The commission's section-4 names are used verbatim; only the VALUES come from the kwapso design kit. There is nothing to bridge and no alias layer, so the token file drops in clean. All 95 section-4 names are present.

notifications.note: Was a 619-line screen. The client ruled it a component (2026-08-24); the PANEL branch is what became the control and the MainScreen page branch was deleted. Export renamed from NotificationsScreen.

iconsAdded.ChevronDown: accordion, select, dropdown-menu and collapsible all need a down chevron; the 93 have ChevronLeft, ChevronRight and ChevronsUpDown but no ChevronDown. Commission rule 3 permits adding; it forbids removing or renaming.
iconsAdded.ChevronUp: select's scroll-up affordance and the collapsed half of a disclosure
iconsAdded.Star: the `rating` primitive in section 6 has no glyph in the 93

compositions.note: RESTRUCTURED 2026-08-24. compositions/ is four folders — templates, screens, overlays, states — and the client's sentence for it is "everything currently compositions/xyz is compositions (and then sections inside of it)". compositions/shapes/, compositions/system/ and compositions/portal/ NO LONGER EXIST. Twenty-four files and 11,731 lines of example collection and detail pages were deleted: the kit ships the TEMPLATE for a main screen and a detail screen, and the application builds the page. Every barrel is compositions/<folder>/index.ts, and compositions/index.ts re-exports all four.

scalesNote: Authoring base is 16px; :root renders 15px. Neither app's default is forced — each sets data-scale on <html>. The portal deliberately sits one step above the system app.

breakpoints.note: Tailwind v4 defaults: sm 40rem / md 48rem / lg 64rem / xl 80rem. Components state their behaviour per breakpoint in their own header comment.

extraDependencies.recharts: ^3.10.1 - the Chart collection. On the commission permitted list but was not installed.
extraDependencies.vite: dev only - builds demo/. Not shipped; consuming apps bring their own bundler.

notDelivered.reason: NOT SUPPORTED, by client decision on 2026-08-22. Kwapso kit ruling 10 already put RTL out of scope; the commission asked for rtl:true and the client has now settled it as LTR-only.
notDelivered.note: The 65 primitives are nevertheless written with CSS logical properties throughout, and motion.css carries [dir=rtl] mirrors for the sheet, tab indicator and stepper connector. That was not reverted: reverting 65 files to physical properties would be pure risk for zero gain, and logical properties resolve identically in LTR. If RTL is ever wanted, the components are most of the way there and the missing piece is a Radix DirectionProvider at the app root.

notDelivered.item: Icon artwork — all 93, plus the 3 added
notDelivered.reason: Placeholder art by instruction: a rounded frame with a per-name dot pattern, deliberately not final and visibly not final. The client is supplying the real icons. The NAMES, the React API, the five sizes and the currentColor wiring are FINAL.
notDelivered.swapProcedure: Drop the real <Name>.svg over the placeholder in icons/, run `node icons/generate-icons.mjs`. No component and no call site changes. The generator reads each file's own viewBox, so incoming art may be drawn on any grid.

notDelivered.reason: There is no warning colour in the kwapso palette — seven brand colours and none is amber. The kit assigns overdue to Poppy, and ruling 26 states mango is the brand, not a status. Folded into danger by decision, so Badge variant="warning" still renders (poppy). --warning-strong resolves identically to --warning rather than inventing a deeper amber.
notDelivered.recommendation: Leave folded, or open a kit ruling to admit an eighth brand colour.

notDelivered.reason: The kit designs three series colours (sky, forest, poppy) and says they cycle. 4 and 5 are placeholders repeating 1 and 2, so a five-series chart currently shows two indistinguishable pairs.
notDelivered.recommendation: Two dedicated data-safe hues need a kit ruling. Never mango (brand, not data) and never grey (reads as disabled).

notDelivered.item: Dark value for --accent, the neutral row/item hover wash
notDelivered.reason: The kit states the light wash at rgba(26,25,24,.05) — the command palette's active row and the destructive menu item, ch12 — and draws no dark twin. Derived by the kit's own hairline method: carry the alpha, flip the ink, giving rgba(255,254,249,.05). Charcoal at 5% on unlit paper would be invisible, so holding the light value would have been a broken hover, not a cautious one.
notDelivered.recommendation: Confirm or replace with a kit ruling. Tracked upstream as T12-3.

notDelivered.reason: Redistribution is an open licence question, not a technical one. Both families are named first in --font-sans / --font-serif with a real fallback stack behind them, so nothing renders blank if the files never land.
notDelivered.recommendation: Resolve the licence, then add the files and an @font-face block.

map.note: Client ruling 2026-08-24, and 27.29 agrees: a map is always paired with the records beside it, which is a collection view.

portal-conversation.note: A thread of bubbles with a composer — the same category as chat and ticket-thread.

iconSizesNote: 28 is the sixth and was admitted by client ruling T2, 2026-08-23: 27.42 draws the module wall's icon at 28 and the ladder had five. Snapping the tile to 24 or 32 was the alternative and was declined.

foundationsFolder.status: NOT DONE — needs a client decision, flagged rather than guessed.
foundationsFolder.reason: The agreed structure groups tokens/, icons/ and motion/ under a foundations/ folder. Thirteen DECISION AND INDEX PAGES under verify/ link tokens/tokens.css and motion/motion.css by relative path, and those pages are the record of what the client was looking at when they ruled. Moving the folders means editing all thirteen. The three folders therefore stay at the repository root for now. The DEMO LABEL 'foundations' is applied regardless, which is the part the client actually asked for.

iconArt.note: Replaced the placeholder set. The commission's 93 + 3 additive spellings survive as aliases in icons/aliases.json; icons/ATTRIBUTION.md records the four normalisations and the seven approximate mappings.
